newsitem.title: USA: Triton boosts shelf offering to $600 mln.
newsitem.headline: Triton boosts shelf offering to $600 mln.

text.p: Triton Energy Ltd on Wednesday said it filed a shelf-registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for an offering of up to $600 million of debt and equity securities.
The statement amends a $500 million shelf registration filed on September 11, the company said.

Triton said proceeds of any future securities sale under the amended registration were expected to be used primarily to provide capital for its exploration and development programs and for general corporate needs. The company may also use some of the proceeds to retire or refinance existing debt obligations.
